## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Explain any checks not run.

- [ ] Changes are focused and preserve existing contracts.
- [ ] Relevant behavior tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] Format, Clippy, tests and release build pass.
- [ ] No private source, caches, credentials or generated build files are included.
